requirements.reason: This cell's OWN prepared Perception artifact for the TRAIN Fold A roster, produced by the model-free core.flight.cli prepare-supply step under this cell's own run id. Zero model, tokenizer, encoder, scorer or server contacts. The slot-audit block is a consumer-side context addition at the reviewer:current-draft boundary and moves no supply, no retrieval and no evidence block, so the artifact's OUTPUT must equal the sealed anchor's on 1,080 of 1,080 rows -- which is the model-free proof that neither declared key moves a knowledge-selection byte. --allow-output-change must never be passed.

failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. Do not automatically restart, replay, filter rows, change the roster, role graph, prompts, geometry or caps. At most one root-diagnosed recovery may be separately registered; a second failure closes this flight and the fix must be proven on a four-row dry run before another mechanism.
